## API Reference

This reference helps you implement the RESTful Pipedrive API. This API uses a JSON format for output and is capable of handling CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) requests. The API is stateless – all requests are validated against an API token. The API token can be [obtained](pipedrive.readme.io/docs/how-to-find-the-api-token) manually from the Pipedrive app.

#### OpenAPI 3

You can click on the "Run in Postman" button below to interact with our API. We have a [tutorial](pipedrive.readme.io/docs/run-pipedrive-api-in-postman-or-insomnia) for using Pipedrive API in Postman or Insomnia, but if you prefer to use a different tool, you can always import our OpenAPI 3 specification files (available for both [ v1](developers.pipedrive.com/docs/api/v1/openapi.yaml) and [ v2](developers.pipedrive.com/docs/api/v1/openapi-v2.yaml) APIs) into your tool of choice.

## OAuth 2.0

Run in Postman

Using OAuth 2.0 is necessary for developing apps that are available in the Pipedrive Marketplace. Authorization via OAuth 2.0 is a well-known and stable way to get fine-grained access to an API. To retrieve OAuth2 tokens you should send requests to the `oauth.pipedrive.com` domain. After registering the app, you must add the necessary server-side logic to your app to establish the OAuth flow. Please read more about authorization step on the [Pipedrive Developers page](pipedrive.readme.io/docs/marketplace-oauth-authorization).

#### Requesting authorization

[image: Copy link]

Authorize a user by redirecting them to the Pipedrive OAuth authorization page and request their permissions to act on their behalf. This step is necessary to implement only when you allow app installation outside of the Marketplace.

API v1

###### Request

GET

/oauth/authorize

###### Query parameters

client\_id

string

required

The client ID provided to you by the Pipedrive Marketplace when you register your app

redirect\_uri

string

required

The callback URL you provided when you registered your app. Authorization code will be sent to that URL (if it matches with the value you entered in the registration form) if a user approves the app install. Or, if a customer declines, the corresponding error will also be sent to this URL.

authorization\_code

authorization\_code

refresh\_token

The authorization code that you received after the user confirmed app installation

#### Refreshing the tokens

[image: Copy link]

The `access_token` has a lifetime. After a period of time, which was returned to you in `expires_in` JSON property, the `access_token` will be invalid, and you can no longer use it to get data from our API. To refresh the `access_token`, you must use the `refresh_token`.

title: Pipedrive MCP Server | Connect Claude & ChatGPT to Your CRM description: Connect your own AI agents directly to your pipeline. Use the official Pipedrive MCP server to securely link Claude, Cursor and custom LLMs to CRM data. image: cdn.was-1.pipedriveassets.com/www-main-renderer/_next/static/media/PipedriveV2.bc8d01f9.png


Connect your AI assistant to Pipedrive with MCP

Empower AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude to securely and reliably work with your Pipedrive data. Find deals, update records, get insights, move opportunities through your pipeline and automate workflows, all from your AI assistant.
Connect with ClaudeOpens in new window
Connect with ChatGPTOpens in new window
Pipedrive is an official connector in Claude and ChatGPT. Find it in the connector directory and connect your account. No manual server setup required.
<Pipedrive MCP>
Trusted by 100,000+ companies in 179 countries

How the Pipedrive MCP server works

The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard that lets AI assistants securely connect to external tools and data sources. With Pipedrive MCP, your AI assistant can securely access and act on your CRM data using natural language.
Step 1: Connect securely
Connect your AI assistant to Pipedrive in minutes via a secure OAuth login. No coding, APIs, middleware or developer support required.
Step 2: Ask your AI to act
Simply tell ChatGPT or Claude what you want to do, using plain language directly from its input box.
Step 3: Get instant results
Your AI assistant can find information, update records, create activities and automate workflows using live Pipedrive data.

Bring Pipedrive into your AI assistant

Sales work is increasingly happening inside AI assistants. Pipedrive MCP brings your CRM into that workflow, giving your AI assistant secure access to your live CRM data so it can help you move deals forward, automate busywork and surface insights instantly.

Query your CRM

Search deals, contacts, organizations and leads. Retrieve pipeline details, analyze sales activity and access customer information in seconds.

Take action

Create and update deals, contacts and activities. Convert leads, schedule follow-ups and keep your CRM up to date without manual data entry.

Automate workflows

Turn meeting notes into CRM records, generate follow-up tasks and automate repetitive sales workflows through natural conversation.

Your best day, every day. With Skills.

...

What is the Pipedrive MCP server?

Pipedrive MCP (Model Context Protocol) connects your AI assistant directly to Pipedrive, allowing it to securely access, update and act on your CRM data using natural language.
* 

What can I do with it?

You can query CRM data, update records and automate workflows directly from your AI assistant. Find deals, update contacts, create activities, analyze pipelines and automate repetitive tasks using natural “plain” language.
* 

Who can use the Pipedrive MCP?

All Pipedrive customers, on every plan. Usage is subject to token limits based on your plan and you can purchase additional tokens if needed.
* 

How do I get started with the Pipedrive MCP server?

Connect your AI assistant to Pipedrive in minutes through secure OAuth, no coding or developer required. See the Pipedrive MCP documentation for step-by-step instructions.
* 

Which AI assistants are supported?

Pipedrive MCP works with any AI assistant that supports custom MCP connections. We provide setup guides for ChatGPT and Claude and other assistants can connect using the Pipedrive MCP server URL.
* 

Does it adhere to my existing Pipedrive permissions?

Yes. Your AI assistant can only access and modify data your Pipedrive user already has permission to view and edit. All actions are recorded in the change log for full auditability.
* 

Is my data safe?

Yes. Pipedrive MCP is built and maintained by Pipedrive and follows our security standards. Your AI assistant can only access data within the scope of your permissions. Your AI provider's own privacy and security policies also apply.
* 

Is there an extra cost?

Pipedrive MCP is available on all Pipedrive plans. Usage is based on token limits included in your plan and additional tokens can be purchased if needed.

##### Get started with developer resources and tools

Kick-start your development with our developer resources. Browse our API Reference and Developer Documentation to learn more and use our Developer Community and API clients on Github for help along the way.  



## Easily connect Pipedrive with other software

Not a developer? No problem! With our flexible open platform, you can connect what you need with Pipedrive using the Zapier app or any of the hundreds of available apps in our Marketplace.

Syncing and sharing your CRM data between Pipedrive and any software, system, or app, like Slack, Zoom, Microsoft Teams and Leadfeeder, is both easy and secure.

## Access the Pipedrive CRM API for free

Every Pipedrive plan comes with an API token that gives you access to our RESTful API for free. This means you can extend and customize your Pipedrive experience to streamline your business processes and improve your CRM software’s functionality and efficiency.

...

##### Create a private app

Private apps are for users in the same company. As private apps aren’t published in our Marketplace, this allows you or your developers to develop exclusive integrations for your business only.  

## Let our API documentation, developer resources and tools help you along the way

In addition to our [API Reference](developers.pipedrive.com/docs/api/v1) and [Developer Documentation](pipedrive.readme.io/), we have a host of connector tools to help you with accessing and using our API:  

- Pipedrive API client libraries and SDKs on Github for PHP, JavaScript (Node JS), Python, .NET and Ruby
- Ready-to-import Open API 3 specification file for Postman, Insomnia, or any API tool of your choice
- An up-to-date changelog for all changes, especially breaking changes



## Built with security in mind

We know that every developer is concerned about the security of REST APIs and CRM account, which is why we keep our API under lock and key.

Access to the Pipedrive API is only possible using the API key or an access token when using OAuth 2.0. Not only does Pipedrive encrypt disks and enforce HTTPS from outside the network, but certain data inside the database is also encrypted when necessary.

We’ve mirrored the rigorous security approach outlined in the [OWASP Framework](owasp.org/www-project-api-security/) to ensure everything is safe. Plus, we take extra steps to keep our API secure by tracking issues like broken object level authorization and broken user authentications.

[**Read more about our security**](pipedrive.com/en/features/privacy-security)

title: Pipedrive launches native MCP server, bringing CRM workflows directly into AI assistants image: www-cms.pipedriveassets.com/Pipedrive-MCP%402x_2026-06-30-114432_vqkf.png


Pipedrive launches native MCP server, bringing CRM workflows directly into AI assistants

New York, June 30, 2026 – Pipedrive, the easy and intelligent CRM for small and medium-sized businesses, today announced the launch of its native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, enabling customers to securely connect Pipedrive with AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude and other MCP-compatible tools.
MCP is an open standard that enables AI assistants to securely connect to external tools and data sources. Through Pipedrive’s native MCP server, AI assistants can interact with live CRM data in real time while respecting existing user permissions and maintaining a full audit trail of actions performed.
Using the Pipedrive MCP server, customers can:
* Search deals, contacts, organizations and leads using natural language
* Create and update CRM records without manual data entry
* Convert leads into deals and manage activities
* Generate pipeline insights and sales analysis
* Turn meeting notes into structured CRM records
* Automate follow-up actions and multi-step sales workflows
* Execute other intelligent automations and continuously evolving AI capabilities
The launch allows sales professionals to access, update and act on CRM data directly from their AI assistant using natural language. Instead of switching between applications, users can search deals, create records, update contacts, schedule activities, analyze pipelines and automate sales workflows from within their preferred AI interface.
“Salespeople increasingly start their day with AI assistants.

...

As AI assistants become increasingly central to daily work, businesses are looking for ways to bring trusted business context into those environments without sacrificing security, reliability or control.
Pipedrive MCP is available to customers on all Pipedrive plans. The server works with any AI assistant that supports custom MCP connections, including ChatGPT and Claude, with setup completed through a secure OAuth connection and no developer resources required.
Read more about Pipedrive MCP here.
**About Pipedrive **Founded in 2010, Pipedrive is the easy, intelligent CRM loved by growing sales teams at small and medium-sized businesses. Intuitive by design, the platform gives businesses complete visibility into their sales pipeline and acts as a single, trusted source for customer and deal data. Pipedrive operates like a virtual team behind every salesperson by automating manual workflows, recommending next-best actions and keeping deals moving.

## OAuth 2.0

Using OAuth 2.0 is necessary for developing apps that are available in the Pipedrive Marketplace. Authorization via OAuth 2.0 is a well-known and stable way to get fine-grained access to an API. string

# Connect your AI assistant to Pipedrive with MCP

Empower AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude to securely and reliably work with your Pipedrive data. Find deals, update records, get insights, move opportunities through your pipeline and automate workflows, all from your AI assistant.

Pipedrive is an official connector in Claude and ChatGPT. Find it in the connector directory and connect your account. No manual server setup required.

Trusted by 100,000+ companies in 179 countries

## How the Pipedrive MCP server works

The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard that lets AI assistants securely connect to external tools and data sources. With Pipedrive MCP, your AI assistant can securely access and act on your CRM data using natural language.

**Step 1: Connect securely**

Connect your AI assistant to Pipedrive in minutes via a secure OAuth login. No coding, APIs, middleware or developer support required.

**Step 2: Ask your AI to act**

Simply tell ChatGPT or Claude what you want to do, using plain language directly from its input box.

**Step 3: Get instant results**

Your AI assistant can find information, update records, create activities and automate workflows using live Pipedrive data.

## Bring Pipedrive into your AI assistant

Sales work is increasingly happening inside AI assistants. Pipedrive MCP brings your CRM into that workflow, giving your AI assistant secure access to your live CRM data so it can help you move deals forward, automate busywork and surface insights instantly.

##### Query your CRM

Search deals, contacts, organizations and leads. Retrieve pipeline details, analyze sales activity and access customer information in seconds.

##### Take action

Create and update deals, contacts and activities. Convert leads, schedule follow-ups and keep your CRM up to date without manual data entry.

##### Automate workflows

Turn meeting notes into CRM records, generate follow-up tasks and automate repetitive sales workflows through natural conversation.

## Your AI assistant gets access. You stay in control.

An official, reliable and fully supported connection built and maintained by Pipedrive.

##### Secure by design

Your AI assistant can only work with information Pipedrive users already have permission to see/edit.

##### Fast and easy setup

Connect in minutes through secure OAuth. No coding, no API development, no developer required.

##### Live CRM data

Your AI assistant works with real-time CRM data, not delayed syncs or outdated information.

## See what your AI assistant can do

##### Ask instead of click

*“Show me all open deals over $10K that haven’t been updated in two weeks.”*

*“Here are my notes from today’s call. Create a deal, contact and follow-up activity.”*

 Opens in new window

##### Create new leads instantly

*"Create a new lead for TechCorp. Contact is Sarah Lee, Head of Sales."*

 Opens in new window

##### Get instant pipeline insights

*“Which deals are most likely to close this month and what are the next steps?”*
